name: Memory Lantern Treehouse
description: A cozy treehouse filled with glowing memory lanterns, old toys, and warm evening light.
prompt: A single emotional nostalgic scene: a wonderful treehouse at dusk, its wooden rooms filled with hundreds of softly glowing glass lanterns, vintage toys, photo frames with blank warm glow, patchwork quilts, string lights, open windows showing fireflies and a starry sky, cozy inviting atmosphere, painterly realism, rich warm colors, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: If memories could glow, I’d keep mine here. 🏡✨ What would your lantern hold?
